0022600018.text: The Philadelphia 76ers host the New York Knicks in an Emirates NBA Cup East Group B game, with the 76ers (3-1, 2nd in the Atlantic) coming off a loss and the Knicks (1-3, 12th in the East) coming off a win. The 76ers lead the 2026-27 season series 1-0 after their 106-100 win in New York on October 20, and the teams split their 2025-26 regular-season meetings 2-2, while the 76ers lost 0-4 to the Knicks in the 2025-26 playoffs. The 76ers are without Ariel Hukporti (Achilles, surgery), Dominick Barlow (back, fracture), Jabari Walker (knee, soreness), and Tacko Fall (quadriceps, strain), and the Knicks are without Jose Alvarado (ankle, sprain).
